Container.Name: github-actions-runner-exporter
Container.Overview: Prometheus exporter for GitHub Actions self-hosted runner status (online/busy), plus repo CI health, PR counts, Dependabot alerts and job run/queue time history, and optional adoption stats (stars, release downloads, repo traffic) for chosen repos, polled from the org API on a rate-limit-friendly cache. Comes with an importable Grafana dashboard.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: prometheus grafana github actions runner metrics exporter ci dependabot

Config.Name: GitHub token
Config.Description: Fine-grained token: All repositories, read on Pull requests, Actions and Dependabot alerts, plus access to the org's self-hosted runners. Adoption traffic also needs Administration read. See the README, Token permissions.

Config.Name: Adoption repos
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated repo names in the org to track stars, release downloads and repo traffic for. Traffic needs Administration read on the token. Leave empty to disable.
